name: Sarah
context: Followed MoneySense couch potato advice perfectly — VFV, XIC, ZAG, ZEB. Looks great on paper. But her FHSA is a ticking time bomb: $16K earmarked for a house down payment in 2 years, yet 100% invested in equities. She duplicated XIC across TFSA + FHSA ($35K total) and VFV across TFSA + FHSA ($36K total) without realizing the concentration. Added energy and gold as 'alternative diversification' — but a single BOC rate decision hits her bonds, banks, and energy simultaneously. A 15% market drawdown wipes $2,400 from her house fund.
shortContext: Couch potato — FHSA time bomb, hidden ETF overlap
